entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Good evening.

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: Hello there, Mifune-sensei. I can't wait[n]for today's session. Your last prediction[n]was practically perfect.

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: By the way, um... who is this boy?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, you needn't mind him. That's just[n]my apprentice.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: If anything, you can think of him as[n]a human-sized stuffed animal. I mean,[n]look how fluffy his hair is.

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: Wait... So he's okay with working for[n]a woman, even though he's a guy?

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: *sigh* Something like that is just[n]unthinkable in my line of work...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I take that to mean something else has[n]happened with your job?

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: Yes. A male coworker of mine was given[n]all the credit for a successful project[n]I poured my soul into...

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: And do you know what my boss told me?[n]He said it was just the natural order of[n]things, because I'm a woman.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: How terrible!

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: That's why I'm thinking of leaving and[n]starting up my own business! I've actually[n]been planning for some time.

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: I'm not sure if we'll be able to find[n]a foothold in the market though...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: In that case, let's ask the tarot! Show us[n]the truth, O divine power...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Yes... I've seen everything.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Hm, the cards have appeared in reverse.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: In other words... it seems as though your[n]business is doomed to failure.

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: No! Wh-What should I do!?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm sorry... but in this case, it appears[n]your fate is inescapable.

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: Inescapable?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: What are your thoughts?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Were you even listening?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: What can we do to help this woman[n]who is so oppressed by the savagery of[n]a male-dominated work environment?
Suggest she gives up.
Change her boss's heart.
Encourage her.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: She came here to have her fortune read[n]and to receive advice. Is that honestly[n]your best suggestion?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I would advise you to think of something[n]else before I use my divine power to[n]curse you.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm not sure I understand what you mean[n]by that.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: As such, I would suggest you think of[n]something else. I have the power to[n]curse you permanently, you know...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: What? It's a little idealistic to expect that[n]will actually work...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Incidentally, what would you say[n]if you wanted to encourage her?
Hrahhh!
Overturn your fate!
Fight the power!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Eek!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Th-That's not encouraging, that's just[n]aggressive! Please reconsider your[n]answer!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Don't be so irresponsible! That's simply[n]not an option!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: How can you expect her to overturn that[n]which is inescapable!?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You know we're talking about her[n]business success, right? This has[n]nothing to do with "the power."

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Reconsider your answer!

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: Overturning fate?

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: That's right... I don't have to follow the[n]rules of this oppressive society!

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: I can do it... I'll reshape every aspect of[n]my antiquated industry!

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: ...My mind is made up. I'm going to quit[n]my job and set off on my own private[n]business venture!

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: And even if I fail, at least I won't be[n]wasting away doing busywork for that[n]sexist bastard anymore...

entries.speaker: Office Lady
entries.en: Thank you, young man! If you'll excuse[n]me, Mifune-sensei.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: H-Huh...?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...You're far too irresponsible,[n][lName]-san! Her misfortune[n]has already been made clear!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The cards will surely back me up on that...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Wh-What!?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I-It seems the sequence of cards has[n]changed... Her financial future is now[n]appearing as extremely successful!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: What did you do?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Are you... Are you psychic? Did you use[n]your powers to change the order of the[n]cards!?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: My divine power is capable of sending[n]people like you down to the depths of[n]hell, you know!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Yes... That has to be it. That's the only way[n]this could happen...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Fate cannot be changed. Fate is absolute...[n]That is how it must be.
You're so stubborn.
Open your mind to change.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: B-But if it's really possible to alter fate,[n]nobody would ever buy these Holy[n]Stones...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That may not be such a bad idea...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But if that possibility were the truth,[n]how would I keep my Holy Stone[n]business intact?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...A-Anyway!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You've changed the flow of destiny twice[n]now, both times coming before my very[n]eyes...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It seems this verification process is[n]turning out to be much more meaningful[n]than I expected!
I can sense Chihaya's[n]intense motivation...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You'll come back again soon, right?[n]Promise me!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Well, that's enough for today.[n]Good night!
